name: Test TCP Delegation to K8s Devbob Pods
description: Test acp_delegate using TCP transport to devbob pods running ACP servers on port 3000

tasks.description: Test TCP delegation to devbob pods via headless service

prompt.template:
Test acp_delegate using TCP transport to connect to devbob pods.

The devbob pods are running ACP servers independently on port 3000.
They have a headless service: devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local

Each pod is accessible via:
- devbob-0.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000
- devbob-1.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000
- devbob-2.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000

Task 1: Test delegation to devbob-0 using TCP transport
```typescript
acp_delegate({
  target: "tcp://devbob-0.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
  taskDescription: "Test TCP delegation to devbob-0",
  prompt: "Please confirm you received this delegation request. Use the bash tool to run 'hostname' and include your hostname in the response. This validates TCP transport is working.",
  timeout: 60
})
```

Task 2: If devbob-0 succeeds, test devbob-1
```typescript
acp_delegate({
  target: "tcp://devbob-1.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
  taskDescription: "Test TCP delegation to devbob-1",
  prompt: "Please confirm you received this delegation request from a different caller than devbob-0. Use bash to run 'hostname'. This validates independent pod connections.",
  timeout: 60
})
```

Task 3: Test parallel delegation to all 3 pods
```typescript
const startTime = Date.now()
const results = await Promise.all([
  acp_delegate({
    target: "tcp://devbob-0.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
    taskDescription: "Parallel test A",
    prompt: "Respond with 'Pod A received task' and your hostname",
    timeout: 60
  }),
  acp_delegate({
    target: "tcp://devbob-1.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
    taskDescription: "Parallel test B",
    prompt: "Respond with 'Pod B received task' and your hostname",
    timeout: 60
  }),
  acp_delegate({
    target: "tcp://devbob-2.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
    taskDescription: "Parallel test C",
    prompt: "Respond with 'Pod C received task' and your hostname",
    timeout: 60
  })
])
const duration = Date.now() - startTime

console.log(`All 3 pods responded in ${duration}ms`)
results.forEach((r, i) => {
  console.log(`Pod ${i}: ${r.output.substring(0, 100)}`)
})
```

Expected results:
- All connections succeed via TCP
- Each pod responds with its hostname
- Parallel execution completes in < 30 seconds
- No docker exec errors

Report:
- Success/failure for each pod
- Hostnames confirmed
- Parallel execution time
- Any connection errors

If TCP connection fails:
- Check DNS: nslookup devbob-0.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local
- Check service: kubectl get svc -n metabob devbob-headless
- Check ACP server: kubectl logs -n metabob devbob-0 | grep ACP
- Try localhost with port-forward as fallback

tasks.description: Test impulse sharing via TCP delegation

prompt.template:
Test impulse sharing across pods via TCP delegation.

Create a test impulse:
```typescript
const impulseId = await impulse_create({
  id: "tcp-test-design",
  type: "memo",
  pointer: {
    type: "memo",
    content: "Test Design Document:\n- Feature: User authentication\n- Method: JWT tokens\n- Endpoints: /login, /logout, /refresh\n- Security: bcrypt password hashing"
  },
  budget: 1500
})
```

Delegate with impulse:
```typescript
const result = await acp_delegate({
  target: "tcp://devbob-1.devbob-headless.metabob.svc.cluster.local:3000",
  taskDescription: "Implement feature from design",
  prompt: "Review the shared design impulse and provide a 3-bullet-point implementation outline. Confirm you received the design document.",
  shareImpulses: ["tcp-test-design"],
  sendFullContent: false,  // Use pointer serialization
  timeout: 90
})
```

Expected:
- Impulse shared via pointer (not full content)
- Remote pod resolves impulse
- Response references design details
- Pointer serialization used (check logs for size reduction)

Report:
- Impulse sharing success/failure
- Whether remote pod resolved the impulse
- Response quality (does it reference design?)
- Serialization efficiency (pointer vs full content size)
